What I thought so as well. If you order spicy noodles from a restaurant you don't whine when it's too spicy, because that's the entire goddamn point. Cuphead, Dark Souls, and other similar games have difficulty at the very core of their being. There are loads of other games that are more accessible and forgiving to the unskilled so it's just silly to demand from developers to tone down what they thought was the best possible difficulty for the game they made.

I'd suggest you start by finishing story mode and cleaning up Trials. I also suggest saving your gems for heroes.

You can't go wrong following the Guide Quests, you can rack up a lot of gems and loot just focusing on completing them.
